{{Quote|Resistance groups from all over the Circarpous system are going to be there. If I don't arrive, they'll panic.|Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="SotME" />}}
The '''conference with the Circarpousian underground''' was an important meeting of local resistance groups in the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous system]] in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was sent to represent the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the belief that Rebel Alliance support could strengthen the [[Circarpous resistance]] movement, leading to [[Circarpous IV]] and its neighboring worlds joining the Rebel Alliance openly. This was a vital mission, as at least one other system was ready to join the Rebel Alliance, but only if the Circarpous system did so.

Unfortunately Princess Leia Organa, along with her escort [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and their [[Droid/Legends|droid]] companions [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were delayed when Princess Leia Organa's [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] suffered a malfunction, forcing her to put down on [[Mimban/Legends|Circarpous V]]. They were further delayed when an [[energy drill]] operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on that world caused atmospheric feedback that wrecked both her and Luke Skywalker's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] on the planet. They were eventually able to escape the planet with the help of a woman named [[Halla]], and continue on their mission to the conference.
